title: Claude 101 - Skills, Connectors and more
description:
Explore Claude Skills, Connectors, Projects, Artifacts, and Plugins — the features that turn Claude into a powerful daily work assistant.

What You'll Learn

  • Claude Skills — reusable capabilities tailored to your work
  • Claude Connectors (MCP) — link Claude to the tools you already use
  • Claude Projects — organize context for ongoing work
  • Claude Artifacts — create and iterate on outputs in real time
  • Claude Plugins — extend Claude with additional capabilities
  • Test your knowledge with the Claude 101 quiz

Who Is This Course For?

  • Professionals who want to unlock Claude's full feature set
  • Anyone ready to move from chat-only to integrated AI workflows
instructorBio: Ava is Approachable's virtual assistant, guiding learners through practical Claude workflows.

faqs.question: Do I need Claude experience?
faqs.answer: Basic familiarity with Claude helps, but the course is beginner friendly.

ogDescription: Learn Claude Skills, Connectors (MCP), Projects, Artifacts, Plugins — plus a quiz to test your knowledge
